race.comment: ARTFUL MAXIMUS (2) is the obvious danger third-up after two solid runs at this venue, the latest better than fifth suggests after he jumped awkwardly, raced wide early and was held up before closing off. Look for a bold run. SHE'S ICONNIC (11) resumes off two trial wins and had excuses when placed as favourite before the break. Expect she is primed for this. THINKIMACELEBRITY (3) has the strongest overall profile despite being freshened since Tatura, where he was seventh but beaten only three and a half lengths after sitting handy and battling on. His Wodonga second to Sheza Raveela two back reads well for a Mdn of this nature, and he has placed at around 1100m before. ARIZONA WILDFIRE (1) backs up quickly after a Hamilton third at long odds, where he was held up near the 300m and still finished within a length and a half of Invisible Caravan. Can give a sight.
